title: Leaderboard with competition ranks and stable ties

crosscheck.reference: naive reference: row list with achievement stamps, selection-sort top, counting rank

cases.name: v4:prompt_example
cases.code:
lb = sol.Leaderboard()
r = [lb.submit("ana", 100), lb.submit("raj", 120), lb.submit("mei", 100)]
r += [lb.rank("ana"), lb.rank("mei"), lb.top(3)]
r.append(lb.submit("ana", 100))
r.append(lb.top(3))
r.append(lb.submit("mei", 130))
r += [lb.rank("ana"), lb.top(2), lb.player_count()]
result = r

cases.name: v4:large_random_sequence
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(0)
lb = sol.Leaderboard()
log = []
for i in range(2500):
    p = "p%d" % rnd.randrange(60)
    s = rnd.randrange(50)
    log.append(lb.submit(p, s))
    if i % 250 == 0:
        log.append([lb.player_count(), lb.top(5)])
ranks = []
for i in range(60):
    p = "p%d" % i
    try:
        ranks.append([p, lb.rank(p), lb.best(p)])
    except KeyError:
        pass
result = [log, lb.top(10), lb.player_count(), ranks]
